ny-suffolk-2026-supreme-court-iliou-john.bio: Acting Supreme Court Justice for over 12 years; former Assistant District Attorney, Assistant Town Attorney, and Law Clerk.

ny-suffolk-2026-supreme-court-mcdonaugh-.bio: Suffolk County District Court Judge who has also served as an Acting County Court Judge.

ny-suffolk-2026-supreme-court-mullen-mar.name: Mary Kate Mullen
ny-suffolk-2026-supreme-court-mullen-mar.bio: Suffolk County District Court Judge serving as an Acting County Court Judge; former Suffolk County Assistant District Attorney and Town of Islip Councilwoman.

il-dupage-2026-appellate-mcdade-o-connel.name: Margaret "Peggy" O'Connell
il-dupage-2026-appellate-mcdade-o-connel.bio: DuPage County Circuit Court Judge and Presiding Judge of the Felony Division; formerly a DuPage County State's Attorney and Senior Assistant Attorney General at the Illinois Attorney General's Office.

il-will-2026-appellate-mcdade-o-connell-.name: Margaret "Peggy" O'Connell
il-will-2026-appellate-mcdade-o-connell-.bio: DuPage County Circuit Court Judge and Presiding Judge of the Felony Division; formerly a DuPage County State's Attorney and Senior Assistant Attorney General at the Illinois Attorney General's Office.

nc-durham-2026-clerk-superior-court-thom.name: Aminah Thompson
nc-durham-2026-clerk-superior-court-thom.bio: Durham County Clerk of Superior Court; former magistrate for fourteen years.

positions.stance: Protecting families and preventing land loss in historically underrepresented communities through strengthened oversight in estates, probate, heir property, partitions, and foreclosures.
Modernizing court operations by expanding remote hearings, implementing eCourts locally, and investing in staff training and smarter resource allocation.
"Building trust through fairness, transparency, and ethical leadership," including confidential reporting systems and data-informed court performance standards.
"Delivering justice with care, accuracy, and compassion" through expanded bilingual services, plain-language materials, and partnerships to remove access barriers.

nc-durham-2026-district-court-16-seat-01.name: Dave Hall
nc-durham-2026-district-court-16-seat-01.bio: Durham District Court Judge since 2018; former indigent defense attorney.

nc-durham-2026-district-court-16-seat-05.name: Christy A. Hamilton Malott
nc-durham-2026-district-court-16-seat-05.bio: Attorney with twenty years of legal experience in civil law, including family, child abuse and neglect, and general civil law.

nc-durham-2026-district-court-16-seat-06.name: Amanda L. Maris
nc-durham-2026-district-court-16-seat-06.bio: Durham County District Court Judge, first appointed in July 2017.

md-anne-arundel-2026-clerk-fowler-mk.name: MK Fowler
md-anne-arundel-2026-clerk-fowler-mk.bio: Chief Deputy Clerk of the Anne Arundel Circuit Court Clerk's Office since 2019; former lawyer in the Office of the Public Defender.

positions.stance: "Customer Service is my highest priority," ensuring proper training, accessible managers and Clerk support for court customers.
Aims to help people navigate the difficult court system when they come to the Anne Arundel County Courthouse.
Strives to make business license, marriage license, and land record processes "as quick and seamless as possible."
